organization.short_description:
About the Group and Equans France

A subsidiary of the Bouygues group, Equans is a global leader in the energy and services sector.

In France, Equans France draws on its heritage brands Ineo, Axima and Bouygues Energies & Services and a strong local presence to support businesses, local authorities and industrial players in tackling the challenges of the triple energy, industrial and digital transition.

Able to act at every stage of a project's lifecycle, Equans France deploys its 35,000 employees to design, install and deliver bespoke solutions that optimise clients' equipment and usage, thereby improving the energy performance and efficiency of infrastructure. Its expertise covers electrical and HVAC engineering, refrigeration, fire safety, Facility Management, multi-technical maintenance, IT, telecommunications and digital solutions.

Globally, the Equans group operates in 20 countries, with 83,000 employees across 5 continents and revenue of €18.72 billion in 2025. Reflecting this dynamic, its subsidiary Equans France posted revenue of €7.2 billion in 2025 and operates in nearly 30 different countries.
